text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After inadvertently finding out one evening that Sakura Chiyono O is considering quitting racing, Mejiro Ardan is left dumbstruck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O laments that a substantial skill gap has emerged between herself and her two rivals, who have improved in the time since she withdrew from racing due to her injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Sakura Chiyono O feeling that there's no point in her returning to racing, Mejiro Ardan asks her to watch the upcoming battle between herself and Yaeno Muteki at the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As long as one has rivals, one can surpass one's limits an infinite number of times.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan burns with the desire to use her running to prove this to Sakura Chiyono O!
